title: situation.texas_governor_changed.title

gate.none: Allegiance and succession in a state office only; no secession-cause claim, slavery policy, security order or protected-population effect.

pp. 113-114, Houston refuses to recognize the Convention; pp. 183-185, his nonappearance for the oath and the vacancy proceedings, 16 March; [I] the existing refusal correspondence and continued incumbency are the State prerequisite, retaining three days after that notice; no claim that the 6 March reply is the later oath refusal
